claims.claim: The console is a PlayStation 4 Pro.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies only a white game console; brand and model were not read from any photo.

claims.claim: It provides the ultimate gaming experience.
claims.evidence: Subjective experience claim; photos cannot show gameplay quality.
Performance claim requires testing the unit; not visible in still photos.

risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: Controllers do not function or pair.
risks.proof: Video of both controllers syncing and being used in a game.

risks.risk: Power adapter voltage is incompatible with Lagos supply.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the power adapter label showing input voltage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a converter or incompatible.

risks.proof: Photo showing all cables, power adapter, and controller cables laid out together.
Video or close-up photos of all sides, ports, vents, and the bottom of the console and controllers.

risks.risk: No warranty or proof of purchase.
risks.proof: Screenshot or photo of a valid warranty card or receipt.

risks.risk: Age or heavy usage shortens remaining life.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the serial or manufacture label and clear shots of wear.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of both controllers pairing and working in a game.
Close-up photo of the console model and serial label.
Close-up photo of the power adapter voltage label.
Photo of all accessories and cables together.
Photo or screenshot of warranty card or purchase receipt.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a white game console with two wireless controllers, so a worst-case price is possible even though the seller's PlayStation 4 Pro claim is unproven.
